scope: Product recommendations from saved catalog and project evidence, not source updates or runtime validation.
routing_method: Editorial area-based routing with explicit mechanism-specific overrides; M7 applies conceptually to all selected feature-loss cases. Counts do not measure independent incidents or priority.

opportunities.M4: Native adapter factory and capability transplantation
opportunities.M6: Cross-language causal debugger and lifetime investigator
opportunities.M7: Reference-app behavior twin and feature-parity oracle
opportunities.M9: Desktop experience, rendering and performance adaptation lab
opportunities.M12: Executable migration knowledge and regression benchmark

knowledge_entries.title: Offer alternate app icons with an honest native capability contract
knowledge_entries.problem: Selectable launcher icons must work conditionally across supported OH device/API versions without false success or overlapping changes.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Package named alternate icons, gate the native API, serialize changes and reconcile the OS-enabled choice before reporting effective state.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test default-to-alternate and reset, an older supported installation target, unknown names, simultaneous requests, native rejection, restart and launcher refresh. Confirm the UI follows enabled state rather than only the last requested name.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose paths in the process that actually uses them
knowledge_entries.problem: A path visible through hdc shell is absent or inaccessible inside the application.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Resolve paths from the owning application context and inspect visibility in the actual process namespace.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test the same intended resource from the app and shell, then verify child-process access only where that route is used.

knowledge_entries.title: Recompute native layout when density changes
knowledge_entries.problem: A PC window keeps its physical size but logical layout becomes wrong after a density or display change.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use the owning UIContext to convert current physical bounds, listen for density changes and merge avoid areas once per edge.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Change density with unchanged physical window bounds, move/resize free windows, vary system bars/cutouts and recreate the UI owner. Confirm correct hit coordinates, no double insets and exact listener removal.

knowledge_entries.title: Make a JavaScript bridge available before an ArkWeb page starts
knowledge_entries.problem: The first inline script cannot find a Flutter bridge even though the same bridge works after the page finishes loading.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Register the message receiver and native document-start scripts before navigation, and acknowledge registration only after the owning Web component applies the script list.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Use a document whose first inline script invokes the bridge. Test cold creation, rapid registration followed by navigation, reload, redirects, allowed and disallowed frames/origins, replacement, removal, and disposal while registration is pending. Record actual first-script execution on the target ArkWeb backend.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep recovery controls outside synthetic game input capture
knowledge_entries.problem: A synthetic game-touch adapter prevents recovery buttons from receiving pointer events.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Exclude native HTML controls and recovery overlays from game-input capture and bind bridge work to the active session.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise game gestures and recovery controls together; test pointer targets inside nested button elements and teardown while selection/write requests are pending.

knowledge_entries.title: Avoid waiting for a stopped event loop during shutdown
knowledge_entries.problem: Shutdown hangs waiting for an asynchronous callback after the native JS environment stops processing work.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Complete cross-runtime work before teardown and use bounded cancellable waits only where the supplying event loop can progress.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test unresolved promises, environment teardown, late callback after timeout and repeated shutdown without blocking the UI.

knowledge_entries.title: Apply the OH audio-session policy for simultaneous playback
knowledge_entries.problem: An allow-simultaneous-playback setting works on Android/iOS but still pauses another application's audio on OH, or audio focus appears retained after playback stops.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Pass the intended OH concurrency policy when activating the native audio session, and verify activation, interruption and deactivation separately.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Use two applications on the target device. Test starting either one first, mixing enabled/disabled, changing the preference while playing, activation failure, interruption followed by manual pause, headphones disconnecting, and stop/dispose/restart. Observe the native session state and both audio outputs; record release separately from Dart callback completion.

knowledge_entries.title: Make partial commit and resume explicit for batched imports
knowledge_entries.problem: An import exceeds a native store transaction limit or fails after earlier batches were committed.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use bounded sequential batches and a durable progress policy rather than claiming whole-import rollback.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Fail before, during and after a batch commit; verify stable record IDs, conflict handling and idempotent resume without duplicate publication.

knowledge_entries.title: Scale uploads and previews without collecting the entire file
knowledge_entries.problem: Attachment uploads or previews exhaust memory or keep temporary files alive after cancellation.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Stream an owned staging file with backpressure and enforce separate transfer and preview limits.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Measure memory for a large attachment and preview; test growth/truncation, same-size mutation, cancelled selection, stalled transfer and cleanup after failure/success.

knowledge_entries.title: Create a reproducible OH build and verify a usable application
knowledge_entries.problem: Analysis passes but native packaging fails, CI publishes an unsigned artifact, or another machine cannot reproduce the build.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Pin the complete OH build environment and verify each stage separately: analysis, native build, packaging, signing, installation and feature execution.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Reproduce from clean inputs; inspect application identity/signature and install output; verify startup and required feature flows on target hardware.

knowledge_entries.title: Copy mutable seed data out of installed resources
knowledge_entries.problem: Updating a bundled configuration, database or model fails with read-only or permission errors.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Read immutable resources in place; initialize mutable copies in platform-provided application data storage before editing.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise first install, populated-data upgrade, failed copy, interrupted initialization and restart; confirm writes target the runtime-resolved directory.

knowledge_entries.title: Calendar import through a receiver has a user-owned completion step
knowledge_entries.problem: Opening a calendar file is incorrectly reported as completed event insertion.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep the file and read grant alive; report receiver opening separately from the user completing calendar import.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test valid/invalid ICS content, missing receiver, denied grant, cancellation and delayed receiver reading. Confirm UI reports handoff rather than an unmeasured inserted-event count.

knowledge_entries.title: Avoid initializing a native backend on an unsupported target
knowledge_entries.problem: A controller crashes during construction or startup even though the UI later hides the unsupported feature.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Select the supported capability before creating native-backed objects. Use lazy construction and explicit unavailable results for excluded backends.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Construct the app and relevant controllers without the optional plugin, then test supported, unavailable and teardown paths. Ensure hidden features never allocate their native objects.

knowledge_entries.title: Transfer large bridge payloads through owned staging files
knowledge_entries.problem: Large JavaScript/native payloads exceed message limits or an interrupted transfer leaves partial or incorrectly acknowledged files.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Send bounded acknowledged chunks to a session-owned staging file, validate ordering and completion, and publish only after a successful commit.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Test multiple chunks, zero bytes, a short final chunk, non-ASCII names, short writes, reordered/duplicate chunks, changed totals, rename failure, timeout, abort and native-view teardown. Confirm an old destination survives every pre-commit failure and the imported/exported bytes match exactly.

See [typed channel payloads](typed-channel-payload-extraction.md) and [file export](file-export-contract.md).

knowledge_entries.title: Scope Clang nesting-limit changes to the failing target
knowledge_entries.problem: A template expansion such as magic_enum exceeds the compiler bracket-depth limit.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Confirm a finite intended expansion and adjust its range or target-local nesting limit instead of changing unrelated build settings.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compile the affected instantiation and test enum conversion boundaries and invalid inputs.

knowledge_entries.title: Transfer app state through OH continuation
knowledge_entries.problem: Continuation needs a synchronous native response, or an incoming reader/document state arrives before its runtime dependencies are initialized.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Maintain a small valid continuation snapshot ahead of time, and restore incoming state only after the destination services and navigation are ready.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test active/inactive activities, cold receiver startup, delayed dependencies, invalid versions, unavailable content and state changes during transfer.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep legitimate playback or transfers running in the background
knowledge_entries.problem: Playback, downloads or an SSH-backed transfer stops when the app leaves the foreground, despite application timers or keepalive packets.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Pair the active user-visible operation with an appropriate native background-task lifecycle, including declarations, authorization, session/notification behavior and cleanup.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test native denial, foreground/background transitions, interruptions, queue completion, disconnect and teardown. Observe actual task/session state and resource cleanup.

knowledge_entries.title: Choose or replace a database backend without losing data
knowledge_entries.problem: A Dart database layer cannot load SQLite on OH, or you are considering a preferences/JSON fallback while an OH database plugin becomes available.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep the storage interface stable, but evaluate engine loading, semantics and existing-data migration separately from package selection.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Test old-data migration, transactions, concurrent writes, restart, corrupt data and interrupted migration in a release app using the actual native backend.

Also test an upgrade with a populated database in the old location and confirm that subsequent restarts use the same migrated data rather than creating another empty database.

knowledge_entries.title: Use holding-hand or other device-specific gestures as optional input
knowledge_entries.problem: You want native device gestures to adjust the application UI, such as moving controls according to how a large-screen device is held.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Expose the gesture as an optional capability/event source and keep a usable deterministic UI when the capability or permission is unavailable.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test supported/unsupported devices, denial, absent/noisy events, repeated side changes and suspend/resume without duplicate listeners.

knowledge_entries.title: Retrieve and apply data after distributed-device discovery
knowledge_entries.problem: The device list appears and synchronization is requested, but configuration/data never arrives or is never applied.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Treat discovery, authorization, publish, synchronization, retrieval and application as separate states with explicit completion/error handling.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test each state separately, including denied access, empty pull results, remote updates, conflicts, device disappearance and successful application of the received value.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep document URI identity separate from path and access grants
knowledge_entries.problem: A selected document cannot be read or written, or a remembered selection stops working after restart.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Preserve the original URI and its operation-specific grant; convert to a path only when the selected native backend requires and permits it.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Select a file and a directory; test cancellation, separate read/write access, restart, revocation and removal of the underlying volume.

knowledge_entries.title: Package an Electron app for OH with the OH builder adapter
knowledge_entries.problem: An Electron app builds for desktop but there is no HAP, or the OH package fails because the Electron engine, OH dependencies or DevEco tool paths are missing.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use an OH-aware electron-builder adapter with a supported prebuilt engine, explicit DevEco tool paths and tablet/2in1-only device classes; restore the engine and OH dependencies idempotently before packaging.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build the HAP and inspect that it contains the engine library, `app.asar`, the declared permissions and tablet/2in1 device types. Install the signed package, confirm the app window opens and the packaged JS runs, and verify the template snapshot matches the built version.

knowledge_entries.title: Serve a web IDE from inside the Electron app
knowledge_entries.problem: A desktop web IDE depends on a local Python or Node server, but the OH device runtime lacks the native extension stack or cannot run the desktop service model.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Run a loopback HTTP server in the Electron main process that serves the bundled frontend and a minimal compatible REST surface, then load it in the app window.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch offline, open a notebook, execute a Python cell, save and reload it. Switch to external mode and confirm it skips the local server. Quit and verify no server process or port remains; relaunch and confirm the port/token handling is stable.

knowledge_entries.title: Inspect the Electron main process on OH
knowledge_entries.problem: The OH Electron main process crashes or hangs before the renderer is usable, or renderer DevTools works but the main process cannot be inspected.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Append --inspect to the host's Electron relaunch arguments, forward the port with hdc fport, and attach Chrome DevTools to debug the main process.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install the debug HAP, forward the port, attach DevTools and confirm the main target appears. Trigger a known main-process error and see the stack. Rebuild without the inspect flag for release and confirm the debug port is not open.

knowledge_entries.title: Match Electron's Node ABI for OH native addons
knowledge_entries.problem: Electron starts on OH, but a native addon fails with a NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch, a missing .node file, an ELF loader error, or a module-registration failure.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Read the ABI and architecture from the target runtime, keep only matching AArch64 OH artifacts, and stub or disable addons whose native dependency cannot be built for the platform.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: For each remaining addon, `require` it in the packaged app, call one representative operation, and compare `process.versions.modules` with the ABI recorded at build time. Confirm the packaged HAP contains only AArch64 `.node` files.

knowledge_entries.title: Execute commands without a PTY on OH
knowledge_entries.problem: A terminal or command feature relies on node-pty, PTY allocation fails, child processes never report exit, or zombie processes accumulate.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use a resident non-PTY shell with pipes and unguessable completion markers, because PTY allocation is denied and child exit events are not delivered.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Run a multi-line command, a command with a non-zero exit code, and a command that exceeds its timeout. Confirm each returns the intended output and status, the next command is not confused by the previous output, and the process table shows no new zombie except after an explicit reset.

knowledge_entries.title: Bridge an Electron app to an older OH runtime
knowledge_entries.problem: The app targets a newer Electron major than the OH runtime provides; it fails at module load on a missing export, uses unsupported single-instance or updater APIs, or enumerates fonts through desktop tools.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Pin the runtime's Electron/Node versions, diff the app's API usage against the runtime exports, and add narrow compatibility modules for missing clipboard, context-menu, single-instance, updater and font APIs.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch offline with no module-load error. Exercise text, image and rich clipboard writes/reads, a context menu, a file dialog, an export window and the font list. Record `process.versions` and confirm each compatibility branch was actually taken.

knowledge_entries.title: Gate Electron features that OH does not provide
knowledge_entries.problem: An Electron app starts on OH but the window cannot be hidden and restored, the custom title bar has no controls, the updater errors, or default folder lookups throw.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Detect process.platform === openharmony and guard desktop-only capabilities at their call sites: window frame, tray/window visibility, updater, dock and default paths.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: On a 2in1 device, confirm the system title bar has working controls, the tray can hide and restore the window, the updater is inactive, startup does not read `appData` unprotected, and the default output directory is writable or chosen by the user.

knowledge_entries.title: Scope a bundled native runtime with a private HNP
knowledge_entries.problem: Two OH apps bundle the same native package name, and installing the second fails because the public HNP is already registered on the device.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Register the bundled .hnp as private so it is application-scoped instead of device-global, avoiding install conflicts with a sibling app that publishes the same package name.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install the sibling app first, then install this app; both installs succeed and neither overwrites the other. Launch both and confirm the bundled runtime works in each. Rebuild from a clean output directory and repeat the install-order test.

knowledge_entries.title: Isolate Electron windows in OH processes
knowledge_entries.problem: An Electron app on OH needs independent browser or utility windows, a child window blocks or crashes the main UI, or multiple app instances must coexist.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Declare non-main abilities with a dedicated process name, use the engine child-process container for render processes, and enable multi-instance only when the product needs it.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Open a secondary window and confirm it runs in the named process (different PID), close it without affecting the main window, and reopen it. Start a second app instance and confirm the configured instance limit. Trigger a failure in the child window and confirm the main window survives.

knowledge_entries.title: Inject an Electron build into the HAP resource layer
knowledge_entries.problem: An Electron app's HAP builds but shows a stale page or blank window, the desktop bundle is not inside the HAP, or changing the frontend does not change the device build.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Treat the desktop build output and the HAP resfile tree as two materialized copies: declare a copy rule from the packaged app's Resources/app and extra resources, rebuild the frontend first, and verify the packaged content.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Change a visible frontend string, rebuild the frontend, inject, rebuild the HAP, install, and confirm the new string appears. Inspect the HAP for the app directory, its main entry and assets, and confirm the engine libraries and icons are still present.

knowledge_entries.title: Run Electron on OH with a ported runtime and authorized JIT
knowledge_entries.problem: A desktop Electron application must run on OH PC/2in1, but its runtime does not load, Chromium starts without a window, or V8 aborts while initializing executable memory.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Ship an OH-built Chromium/Node/Electron runtime, declare only supported device classes, and verify writable-executable-memory authorization in both the manifest and the signing profile.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install the signed HAP on a 2in1 device. Confirm the window opens, `process.versions` reports the ported Electron/Node versions, a JIT-dependent code path completes, and the installed profile lists the ACL. When the ACL is absent, verify that the documented non-JIT fallback starts without crashing.

knowledge_entries.title: Attach an Electron window to the OH status bar
knowledge_entries.problem: The OH host launches secondary abilities only after a status-bar item is registered, or file-open Want events never reach the running Electron app.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Register the status-bar item before the host attaches secondary abilities, restore the first live window on click, and bridge file-open Want URIs into the app second-instance path.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch the app and trigger the host's secondary ability; confirm it attaches only after the status-bar item exists. Click the tray and verify the existing window is shown and focused. Open a file from the host while the app is running and while it is closed, and confirm both reach the same validated open-file path.

knowledge_entries.title: Create sub and floating windows in an Electron OH app
knowledge_entries.problem: An Electron app opens child windows, popups or floating panels on OH, but they fail to appear, lose their parent, accumulate after closing, or a floating window is blocked by a missing permission.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use the host's windowInfo type (mainWindow, subWindow, floatWindow), create OH subwindows with a parent and bounds, and reuse/minimize them instead of creating independent abilities.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Open a child window and confirm it stays above its parent and moves with it. Minimize, close and reopen it several times; the cache should reuse a window and not grow without bound. Open a floating panel, verify topmost behavior and permission handling, then quit and confirm no subwindow remains.

knowledge_entries.title: Apply a narrowly scoped native compatibility patch reproducibly
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH plugin/embedding API mismatch requires a source patch, but the affected source is downloaded or generated during the build.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Prefer a compatible release; when a patch is necessary, pin its input, apply it at the correct build stage and verify both matching and behavior.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build from clean dependency inputs, verify patch application and packaging, then exercise the specific affected keyboard/window/WebView/native-asset behavior.

knowledge_entries.title: Deep actions require a receiver contract as well as a valid URI
knowledge_entries.problem: A valid deep-action URI opens no receiver or opens the wrong screen.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Validate receiver routing and encoded parameters; distinguish accepted launch from completed navigation.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test cold/warm receiver, encoded special characters and supplementary Unicode, unsupported routes, absent receiver and launch rejection. Confirm accepted launch is distinct from destination navigation.

knowledge_entries.title: Open or share a generated file with another OH application
knowledge_entries.problem: Another app cannot read a private export, a calendar import fails, or an external player rejects the value passed through a channel.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Prepare a receiver-compatible file, expose it through the appropriate URI/access mechanism, and distinguish handoff acceptance from completed consumption.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test a present and absent receiver, URI grant denial, cancellation, content validity, delayed opening and cleanup timing.

knowledge_entries.title: Use the target c_char type in native bindings
knowledge_entries.problem: A native binding fails on OH because it hard-codes signed character pointers.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Model C ABI types with the toolchain's c_char definitions and regenerate or narrowly repair mismatched bindings.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Cross-compile bindings and round-trip ASCII, non-ASCII and bytes above 127 with correct ownership.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose FFI library and missing-symbol failures on OH
knowledge_entries.problem: An FFI call fails to load a library, or an optional operation crashes even though native initialization appeared successful.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Validate the actual packaged library and every required symbol, including symbols resolved only when an optional feature is used.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test clean installation, release startup, optional native calls, invalid inputs and missing-library cases. Verify any safety/resource limit lost by a fallback.

knowledge_entries.title: Save a file where the user can actually access it
knowledge_entries.problem: An export reports success but the user cannot find the file, or a save dialog returns a destination without writing the content.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Separate private persistence, destination selection and export completion. Report export success only after the selected destination contains the intended bytes.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Export empty, small and large files; cancel and deny access; simulate a full destination. Open the successful result from another app and compare its contents.

knowledge_entries.title: Identify file-backed secret storage by its actual protection
knowledge_entries.problem: A file-backed credential provider is mistaken for encrypted or hardware-protected storage.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Describe filesystem access control and replacement guarantees accurately and select the provider only when they meet policy.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Verify access controls, key/path validation, missing versus denied records, interrupted replacement and actual OH provider selection. Confirm no encryption claim is made without that mechanism.

knowledge_entries.title: Separate WebView page zoom from application paint zoom
knowledge_entries.problem: Application scaling and ArkWeb zoom multiply twice or reset incorrectly.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep page zoom independent from Flutter paint transforms and preserve the original page style when using a CSS fallback.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Vary application scale and page zoom independently and together; check taps/selection, existing root CSS zoom, navigation, reset to 1x, script removal and JavaScript-disabled fallback.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose mixed compiler/engine caches before changing application semantics
knowledge_entries.problem: Flutter startup fails despite matching version strings.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Align compiler, platform kernels, engine and embedding artifacts from the same pinned distribution.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Rebuild from a clean compatible SDK cache, verify component identities/hashes and test release startup. Confirm the original first failure is gone without a semantic workaround.

knowledge_entries.title: Synchronize native material settings as effective state
knowledge_entries.problem: A Flutter setting claims a native HDS material level is applied before the shell accepts it.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Validate one typed setting map and replay desired material state after native readiness, preserving failed requests for retry.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Change material before shell readiness, recreate the shell, reject invalid stored values and simulate unsupported SDK/send failure. Verify desired and applied states stay distinct.

knowledge_entries.title: Branch custom renderers by the active output type
knowledge_entries.problem: A texture-only custom widget shows no picture for a native platform-view backend.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Mount the widget matching the active native output and reconstruct through the same queue when the host changes.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test texture and native-view outputs, delayed dimensions, controller replacement, in-app overlays, rapid entry/exit and disposal during reconstruction.

knowledge_entries.title: Detect the OH PC form factor and branch the Flutter shell
knowledge_entries.problem: A Flutter app should feel desktop-like on OH 2in1 but mobile-like on OH phones/tablets, yet Platform.isOhos alone cannot distinguish them, so windows, fullscreen or back behavior are wrong.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Expose the OH device type from the native side, flag 2in1 as PC, and include it in the Dart desktop/mobile branches before choosing layout, fullscreen and back behavior.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Run on a phone/tablet and on a 2in1. Confirm the correct layout branch is chosen, fullscreen hides both system bars, maximize/restore works, back returns to the desktop as intended, and the app survives rotation and window resize.

knowledge_entries.title: Vendor Flutter packages for the OH TargetPlatform value
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH Flutter build fails on a non-exhaustive TargetPlatform switch in a third-party package, or a package silently falls back to Android behavior for OH.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: The OH Flutter SDK adds a TargetPlatform.ohos value; vendor or fork packages with exhaustive TargetPlatform switches, add an explicit OH case, and pin the overrides.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build OH without non-exhaustive-switch errors, then verify the affected widget shows the intended desktop/mobile behavior on a 2in1 and a phone/tablet. Rebuild Android/iOS and confirm their behavior is unchanged and the override is still pinned.

knowledge_entries.title: Package versioned native libraries in a Flutter OH build
knowledge_entries.problem: A Flutter OH HAP builds successfully but white-screens or crashes at startup because a versioned native library such as libmpv.so.2 is missing from the packaged libs.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Patch the OH toolchain's native-asset copy filter so libraries such as libmpv.so.2 are packaged, then verify the HAP library set and the AOT engine artifacts.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install the HAP and confirm startup no longer reports a missing library. Inspect the packaged libs for the versioned filename and its closure. Rebuild after an SDK update with the patch re-applied and repeat the check.

knowledge_entries.title: Await native teardown before replacing a backend
knowledge_entries.problem: A player replacement races asynchronous native disposal or late stream events.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use one idempotent teardown Future, cancel subscriptions and await native release before replacement.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test repeated dispose, late stream events, delayed/rejected native disposal and rapid replacement; verify one release and no replacement before required release completion.

knowledge_entries.title: Serialize surface reconstruction with source loading
knowledge_entries.problem: Changing renderer options races loading or leaves a new controller bound to old views.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Serialize source and output changes, retain retry state and rebind all controller-owned subscriptions.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Change source/output options rapidly, fail a rebuild, retry with no player and replace the controller after widget mount. Verify pause, position, speed and track rebinding.

knowledge_entries.title: Recover connections and save state around app suspension
knowledge_entries.problem: Resuming the app unnecessarily reconnects a healthy transport, or recent edits disappear after the app is suspended or terminated.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Separate transport health, application readiness and durable save completion. Use lifecycle callbacks as additional recovery/save opportunities rather than guarantees.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test rapid pause/resume, slow servers, confirmed socket loss, termination during saving, corrupt-state recovery and stale reconnect completion.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve encoded image format across a file-based gallery API
knowledge_entries.problem: An image saved through a temporary file is misclassified or loses its original format.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Match validated encoded bytes to suffix and MIME type, await gallery consumption and clean up the owned staging file.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Save PNG, GIF and JPEG bytes with matching metadata; test invalid/truncated input, cancellation, native failure and cleanup failure. Compare gallery bytes and staging lifetime.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose EACCES when launching a packaged native executable
knowledge_entries.problem: An ELF executable exists in the HAP but execve returns EACCES or chmod returns EPERM.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Validate executable packaging, platform signing authorization, process-visible path and ELF dependencies as separate requirements.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Check declaration, signing and native loader diagnostics independently; run the intended entrypoint with resources and child-process cleanup.

knowledge_entries.title: Resolve device API incompatibility without falsifying the minimum
knowledge_entries.problem: HAP installation reports an older device SDK than the required compatibleSdkVersion.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Compare the device API with the real minimum required by the application and its native dependencies before changing the manifest.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Cover minimum-supported and older-rejected devices, plus capability-gated optional calls.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep product signing and application identity consistent
knowledge_entries.problem: A HAP is unsigned, rejected, or launches under an unexpected bundle identity.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Align application/module identity with the selected product's signingConfig and authorized profile.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Inspect selected product identity/signature and verify the installed app's identity and data location.

knowledge_entries.title: Select HDR output for the active video surface and display
knowledge_entries.problem: An HDR source looks washed out or dark on OH, or loses its picture when switching between embedded playback, fullscreen and picture-in-picture.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Choose the output surface, HDR signaling and tone-mapping target together; use an explicit SDR fallback when the selected path cannot carry HDR.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test SDR and each supported HDR format, supported/unsupported/unknown display results, embedded and fullscreen layouts, system PiP and in-app mini-player round trips, rapid source changes, pause preservation and rebuild failure recovery. Check actual native output metadata and visible results on the target display; verify that fallback output is tone-mapped rather than merely relabeled.

knowledge_entries.title: Verify that a requested native rebuild actually ran
knowledge_entries.problem: Hvigor finishes quickly but packages stale native libraries or skips the intended native build.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Confirm toolchain inputs, task execution and artifact hashes before treating a successful packaging command as a native rebuild.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Use a traceable native change, observe compilation and final packaged hash, then verify launch with the rebuilt artifact.

knowledge_entries.title: Deliver incoming shares or deep actions during cold startup
knowledge_entries.problem: An external share, card action or native launch event is lost before the application subscribes, or is replayed twice after startup.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Buffer native launch payloads until the application runtime explicitly becomes ready, then consume each payload with a defined delivery policy.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Test cold and warm launches, delayed engine/service setup, duplicate events, malformed payloads and process death before acknowledgement.

Also test consumption followed by runtime-start, executor-submission or handler failure; failed diagnostic persistence; bounded-record eviction; and ordinary launch with invalid activation fields. Report submitted, delivered and retained-for-diagnosis as different outcomes.

knowledge_entries.title: Coalesce expensive I/O triggered by text editing
knowledge_entries.problem: Every keystroke starts parsing or file I/O, causing stalls, races or stale results.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use an owned restartable debounce or an explicit submit action, then validate input and correlate results with the current edit generation.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test rapid typing, same-value revisits, invalid/large files, empty parsing and navigation during work.

knowledge_entries.title: Separate JIT memory authorization from ordinary allocation failure
knowledge_entries.problem: A JIT runtime aborts while initializing executable memory or its code cache.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Confirm the allocation failure and verify both the declared capability and the actual signing/profile authorization.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Inspect granted capability and crash logs, then test startup, code generation and shutdown using the intended release/debug signing path.

knowledge_entries.title: Host a KuiklyUI KMP page in an OH app
knowledge_entries.problem: A KuiklyUI app needs to run on OH/PC, or the page renders but custom views/modules, fonts or resources are missing because the host was only partially wired.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Combine the Kotlin/Native business .so, the Kuikly renderer HAR with its C++/NAPI library, and an ArkTS host that passes resource dirs/fonts and registers custom views and modules.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Open the first page and confirm it paints. Navigate to a page with a custom view, call a custom module, render a bundled font and load a resource from resfile/rawfile. Rebuild after changing the Kotlin product and confirm the new behavior appears.

knowledge_entries.title: Synchronize KuiklyUI root-view resize events on OH
knowledge_entries.problem: A KuiklyUI page flashes white or lays out one frame late after OH window rotation, split-screen resize or a host container size change, while normal navigation renders correctly.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: When rotating, splitting or resizing the OH window leaves a white frame, make the rootViewSizeDidChanged event synchronous in the Kuikly view delegate instead of dispatching it asynchronously.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Rotate, split, maximize/restore and resize the window repeatedly. The page should update without a white frame and remain interactive. Confirm other events still arrive in the expected order and the UI thread is not blocked during resize.

knowledge_entries.title: Mount a Kotlin/Compose shared library in an OH HAP
knowledge_entries.problem: The Kotlin/Native Compose library builds for OH, but the HAP cannot create the UI controller, the screen stays blank, or the native link fails on the main controller or shared-library symbols.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Export a C entrypoint from Kotlin/Native, link it with the Compose bridge into a NAPI module, and mount it through the ArkTS Compose component with lifecycle forwarding.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install the HAP and confirm the Compose screen renders. Exercise back navigation, page hide/show, a string resource and an image resource. Inspect the packaged library's dynamic symbols and `DT_NEEDED` entries to confirm the header, library and bridge versions agree.

knowledge_entries.title: Add an OHOS Compose target without breaking Android and desktop
knowledge_entries.problem: A shared Compose Multiplatform project builds for Android and desktop, but adding a HarmonyOS target fails because ohosArm64 is unresolved, desktop artifacts disappear, or Android fails with duplicate androidx classes.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep the Compose plugin on the OH-adapted version, add ohosArm64, and redirect only the OH-excluded target classpaths to the official artifacts.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build the OH shared library and confirm both the `.so` and its generated header exist. Build and run the desktop target and assemble the Android target; neither should resolve the adapted artifacts. Search the dependency graph for duplicate `androidx` groups, and compile a `commonMain` resource reference to prove resource generation still works.

knowledge_entries.title: Choose OH-built KMP libraries and a Compose renderer
knowledge_entries.problem: A shared Compose Multiplatform app builds for Android and iOS but OH fails to resolve the Ktor engine, Coil or navigation artifacts, or renders incorrectly because the Compose renderer mode is wrong.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Pin OH-compatible KMP artifacts, select a platform-specific Ktor engine in ohosArm64Main, and choose exactly one Compose renderer (Skia self-render or unified).
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: On OH, perform an HTTP request, load a network image and navigate between screens. Confirm the expected renderer is active from the build configuration and logs. Rebuild Android and iOS and confirm their engine selections and behavior are unchanged.

knowledge_entries.title: Load Compose rawfile images through the OH resource manager
knowledge_entries.problem: Compose resources or images bundled in rawfile fail to load in a Kotlin/Native OH app, or the UI shows blank images even though the files exist in the HAP.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Pass the UIAbility resource manager into Kotlin/Native through NAPI, read bundled rawfile images with the OH resource APIs, and decode them into Compose image bitmaps off the main thread.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Display a bundled image on OH and confirm it renders with the expected dimensions. Request a missing resource and confirm the placeholder path instead of a crash. Repeat navigation and rotation to check that no rawfile or bitmap leaks, and verify the same screen still works on another platform.

knowledge_entries.title: Recover OH live playback without reacting to weak signals
knowledge_entries.problem: Live playback switches lines unnecessarily, stalls after buffer tuning, or reports recovery before a meaningful native confirmation.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Classify playback evidence, bound recovery and use generation-safe optional line/buffer policies with a stable system-default fallback.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Exercise brief pulses, a long start/end-only stall, unavailable telemetry, paused playback, delayed old events, manual changes during probing, denied/slow endpoints, strategy rejection and rapid source replacement. Verify a finite recovery budget, correct units for percent versus milliseconds, preserved request headers and separately measured first-frame recovery.

See [native playback observations](native-playback-state-observation.md) for the underlying readiness signals.

knowledge_entries.title: Add an optional HarmonyOS Live View without losing the fallback
knowledge_entries.problem: A course, delivery or task countdown needs a system Live View, but devices, user settings or service admission can prevent it from being shown.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep the business operation and fallback independent of Live View; serialize native lifecycle requests, preserve sequence state and distinguish support, enablement and accepted results.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise supported and unavailable devices, a disabled user setting, denied service access, rejected template data and failed sequence persistence. Test concurrent updates, restart, already-active and already-ended scenes, rapid phase changes and final stop. Confirm the native result and visible surface separately, and verify the notification/card remains usable when Live View fails.

knowledge_entries.title: Adapt local authentication without bypassing the application lock
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH application lock uses biometrics or device PIN, but unavailable hardware, cancellation or fallback can accidentally unlock the app or leave a pending request.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Preserve the authentication policy across capability checks, native attempts and fallback; grant access only for a successful current attempt.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test absent enrollment, unsupported trust levels, permission errors, biometric-only policy, approved PIN fallback, cancellation, repeated taps, leaving the screen and stale callbacks. Verify that every non-success path leaves the lock intact and completes its request.

knowledge_entries.title: Adapt gallery saving and clipboard access to OH
knowledge_entries.problem: An Android-oriented photo-save or clipboard path fails on OH, requests irrelevant permissions, or silently supports fewer data types.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Choose the OH media/clipboard operation first, then request only the permissions and user interaction that operation requires.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Check denied/empty clipboard reads, unsupported clipboard types, gallery visibility, saved bytes, cancellation and partial batch failure on the intended devices.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve time-base semantics when replacing a removed media API
knowledge_entries.problem: A native media dependency no longer declares the function used to read a codec time base.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Identify the time domain consumed by the caller and choose a replacement with equivalent units and meaning.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test representative audio/video timestamp conversion, variable frame rate, seeking and reported durations against known media.

knowledge_entries.title: Replace glibc-private names at the native ABI boundary
knowledge_entries.problem: OH native compilation rejects __pid_t, __uid_t or a glibc-only in6_addr member.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use public POSIX types and explicit byte-layout handling instead of reproducing glibc internals.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compile public-header probes and verify IPv6 byte sequences and formatting on the intended architectures.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep Node-API values on their owning environment and handle lifetime
knowledge_entries.problem: Native callbacks crash when a JS value crosses threads or is reused in a later asynchronous turn.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Marshal JS work to the owning environment and pass ordinary native values across threads; retain JS objects with the supported persistent-reference mechanism when needed.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise delayed callbacks, garbage collection, worker delivery and environment teardown; verify values and references remain valid only for their declared lifetime.

knowledge_entries.title: Add optional native image enhancement without blocking reading
knowledge_entries.problem: You want an OH-native AI image feature, but capability availability, latency or failures must not make the original image unusable.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Display the original content immediately, invoke enhancement through a bounded binary-data bridge, and replace the image only with a still-relevant successful result.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test unavailable capability, large images, timeout, rapid navigation, cache invalidation, output quality and measured memory/frame costs.

knowledge_entries.title: Host local web content in a native ArkWeb ability
knowledge_entries.problem: An application launches a web game or other specialized local web runtime that needs native window, resource and bridge control.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use a deliberate native-host boundary with a scoped local origin, a typed session and explicit launch/return lifecycle.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test earliest script calls, origin restrictions, encoded traversal, symlinks, allowed/disallowed remote requests, session replacement and ability return flow.

knowledge_entries.title: Load native libraries from supported code locations
knowledge_entries.problem: dlopen rejects a library copied into cache or another writable data directory.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Package fixed native code through the supported HAP distribution path and diagnose loader policy separately from ABI and dependency failures.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Confirm the library loads from the installed package in a clean app and that each required symbol/dependency resolves; separately observe the rejected-path case.

knowledge_entries.title: Package the complete native dependency closure
knowledge_entries.problem: A packaged native library links successfully but fails to load because a versioned SONAME or indirect dependency is absent.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Trace NEEDED entries and required exports recursively, then package supported ABI-compatible dependencies using the names the loader requests.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Load from a clean package and exercise each enabled feature; inspect the installed dependency chain and diagnostics.

knowledge_entries.title: Make native dependencies reproducible outside a developer machine
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH application references a local HAR, missing submodule, ignored bridge package or cached native binary and fails on a clean checkout.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inventory every native build input and replace unexplained local dependencies with explicit, retrievable sources or documented artifact-generation steps.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build in an environment without developer-local caches/paths, inspect required artifacts and initialize each native dependency in the resulting app.

knowledge_entries.title: Release native handles after event-loop use has stopped
knowledge_entries.problem: A native conversion or playback task crashes on cancellation or shutdown, particularly after changing a native library or event-loop implementation.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Separate callback detachment, worker shutdown and native destruction; release each handle once after every event-loop user has finished.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise normal completion, cancellation before creation returns, cancellation during an event callback, shutdown racing cancellation, repeated dispose, and slow/stalled event-loop exit. Observe handle lifetime and callback activity with native diagnostics; a test that only checks timer order does not establish freedom from use-after-free.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep shared Rust–Dart FFI buffers alive until their last consumer finishes
knowledge_entries.problem: A native OH Rust–Dart bridge moves large binary payloads and copying is expensive, or a retained typed-data view outlives its native allocation.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Separate the byte allocation from its ownership handles, seal producer buffers before sharing, and retain native ownership before asynchronous use or VM delivery.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test delayed native consumption after Dart drops its reference, subranges, empty buffers, foreign-runtime rejection, malformed envelopes, failed port delivery, disposal with work in flight and collection after the last view is dropped. Instrument retain/release counts and memory over repeated large transfers. Measure copy counts and end-to-end performance before making zero-copy or speed claims.

knowledge_entries.title: Read current domain data when a saved display snapshot is insufficient
knowledge_entries.problem: A home-screen card shows stale daily data while the application runtime is absent.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use a verified native read-only data provider and derive fresh display state without starting the main runtime.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test the app closed across a day boundary, multiple form IDs, removal during refresh, missing database and schema upgrade. Confirm current payloads and closed native cursors/stores.

knowledge_entries.title: Build an OH home-screen card backed by application data
knowledge_entries.problem: You want a home-screen Form card that shows application data or opens an application action while the app may not be running.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep card rendering and its initial data response native; publish stable snapshots from the application runtime and route card actions through a readiness-aware bridge.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Add a card with the app closed; test multiple instances, removal, schema upgrades, day-boundary freshness, scheduled refresh and cold-start action delivery.

knowledge_entries.title: Add an OH host without rewriting portable Flutter features
knowledge_entries.problem: You are starting an OH target and need to decide what belongs in Flutter versus native code.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep portable UI and domain logic in Dart; add the OH host and native implementations only where the app crosses a platform boundary.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Confirm a signed app launches on the intended device, then test all native-backed features and preserve regression checks for other supported targets.

knowledge_entries.title: Resolve an OH linker or optimization-probe incompatibility
knowledge_entries.problem: A native build fails in an optimization/link step that succeeds on another platform, or a nested CMake probe cannot use the OH toolchain.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Reduce the failure to the specific toolchain interaction and change only the incompatible flag or probe.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Rebuild the final artifact, inspect ABI/dependencies and run native functionality. Compare size/performance when changing optimization behavior.

knowledge_entries.title: Give each packaged native library one build producer
knowledge_entries.problem: Hvigor ProcessLibs reports duplicate .so files from native intermediates and the manual libs input.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Choose either integrated native build output or an explicit prebuilt input for each logical library.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Reproduce the conflict, regenerate from clean derived output and verify one consistent library per ABI.

knowledge_entries.title: Detect actual playback progress and reject stale player events
knowledge_entries.problem: The player reports initialized/playing but has not rendered, or late completion/events affect a newly selected stream.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use native observations correlated with the current player generation; keep requested state separate from confirmed state.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test delayed/missing first frame, rapid source switching, replay after completion, rejected commands and external changes to system state.

knowledge_entries.title: Bridge native QR scanning without confusing startup with a result
knowledge_entries.problem: A cross-platform scanner lacks an OH backend, returns before recognition, or receives stale results after stopping and retrying.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Model scanning as a capability-gated session with correlated result events, explicit cancellation and cleanup.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise permission denial, user cancel, repeated taps, start failure, disposal during permission/presentation, stop followed by retry, missing event listeners and delayed old results. Confirm one application result per session and truthful controls. Verify the selected service on a supported device.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose a missing native plugin or method handler
knowledge_entries.problem: A native-backed call throws `MissingPluginException`, never reaches ArkTS, or uses the wrong platform implementation.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Trace the call through Dart backend selection and native registration on the same engine before changing the feature implementation.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Call one implemented method after a full restart, test an unsupported method, and check engine teardown/recreation. For multiple engines, test each independently.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep native navigation and theme in sync with Flutter
knowledge_entries.problem: Native tabs, status surfaces or window controls disagree with Flutter navigation/theme, especially during startup or after native view recreation.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Define state ownership and a readiness handshake, then replay the latest state when the native shell becomes ready.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test theme/navigation changes before readiness, native recreation, listener cleanup, phone/desktop behavior and close/reopen/exit flows.

knowledge_entries.title: Give native surfaces one lifetime owner
knowledge_entries.problem: A surface handle becomes invalid during resize/recreation, or mixing surface APIs causes creation failure.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Choose a coherent surface-management API and stop renderer use before its owning node or surface is destroyed.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Cover mount/unmount, resize, hide/show, recreation, mouse/touch/key input and accessibility. Treat the coexistence hypothesis as unverified until measured.

knowledge_entries.title: Read large URI selections through bounded native handles
knowledge_entries.problem: Large selected files allocate their entire content before the importer can stream them.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Return selection metadata first and read through owned bounded native descriptors with serialized read/close operations.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Measure memory during selection and ranged reads; test empty content, premature EOF, oversized chunks, changed content, invalid tokens, cancellation and detach during a pending read. Verify descriptors return to baseline.

knowledge_entries.title: Replace a missing UUID dependency without changing identifier semantics
knowledge_entries.problem: Native compilation cannot find uuid/uuid.h or link libuuid in the selected OH SDK.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Determine the UUID operations actually required and use a compatible target implementation or a narrowly defined adapter.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test binary/text round trips, invalid input, formatting, generation behavior and all functions actually used by callers.

knowledge_entries.title: Wait for authenticated state in a native Web login flow
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH-native login page closes before session cookies are written, returns incomplete credentials, or leaves a request waiting after the user goes back.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Define authentication completion by the required session state, and give success, cancellation and failure distinct one-time outcomes.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test delayed cookies, redirects, cancel/back, repeated login, missing success keys, expiry and cleanup after the page has disappeared.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve HTTP behavior when changing the OH transport adapter
knowledge_entries.problem: Connection testing succeeds but uploads/downloads fail, or switching away from a native HTTP library changes TLS, timeout, proxy or cancellation behavior.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Build all client operations from one explicit transport policy and propagate it consistently into the OH adapter.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise valid/invalid certificates, cancellation, timeout, upload/download and retries against the same endpoint. Confirm default validation remains strict.

knowledge_entries.title: Normalize numeric preferences at the codec boundary
knowledge_entries.problem: A persisted integral double returns as an integer and breaks a typed preference consumer.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Accept verified finite numeric representations at the read boundary while preserving validation and legitimate zero.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Round-trip fractional and integral values, zero, missing data, strings, nonfinite numbers and out-of-range input.

knowledge_entries.title: Complete browser OAuth without losing or accepting the wrong callback
knowledge_entries.problem: Browser authorization returns to the app but login times out, is cancelled too early, or consumes a stale deep link.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Arm an attempt-scoped callback receiver before opening the external browser, then validate and settle the authorization flow once.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise a fast callback, delayed runtime readiness, cold launch, unrelated deep links, wrong state/path, duplicate callbacks, server denial, explicit cancel, timeout and a late callback after retry. Confirm one token exchange per accepted attempt and no authenticated state after failure.

knowledge_entries.title: Replace an unavailable OCR backend while preserving the app contract
knowledge_entries.problem: Your OCR package has no usable OH native implementation, or an old platform guard disables OCR even after adopting a different backend.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep OCR behind an app interface and reevaluate capability support against the selected backend, model packaging and target device.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test bundled model loading, recognition/error/cancel behavior, representative scripts/images, memory pressure and output quality.

knowledge_entries.title: Recover application data when normal application startup fails
knowledge_entries.problem: A corrupt bootstrap file, database or plugin prevents the normal application from opening the screen needed to export or recover its data.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Provide a minimal recovery entry before normal runtime initialization, obtain exclusive storage access, and restore through verified staging with a resumable publication journal.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Inject invalid bootstrap bytes, database-open failure and normal-plugin failure. Open recovery, contend with a live writer, export and restore known data, reject malformed/truncated archives, and interrupt each publication phase. Verify normal startup stays blocked until explicit completion and that retained originals, identities and required credentials remain recoverable.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep native target inputs separate from host build tools
knowledge_entries.problem: Cross compilation finds host libraries or produces a binary for the wrong platform.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use a coherent OH target compiler/sysroot/runtime and resolve host generators separately from target libraries.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Rebuild with clean declared inputs, inspect tool commands and final ELF metadata, then initialize the library in the target app.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose OHPM registry failures before changing dependencies
knowledge_entries.problem: ohpm install times out or cannot reach its registry.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Check the configured client, registry and network/proxy path before altering lockfiles or dependency versions.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Verify retrieval in the actual build environment and confirm the resolved dependency identities remain intentional.

knowledge_entries.title: Reopen a selected folder after restart or permission changes
knowledge_entries.problem: A folder selected earlier stops working after restart, a media scan loses access, or a native library cannot open a remembered external path.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Persist supported URI access grants and reactivate them before I/O. Track access loss separately from file deletion.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Restart, revoke access, disconnect/reconnect a volume and delete one real file. Verify native I/O succeeds after restoration and only confirmed deletion triggers cleanup.

knowledge_entries.title: File picker hangs after cancellation or repeated taps
knowledge_entries.problem: A file-selection future never completes after the user closes the native dialog, or repeated taps open overlapping pickers.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Model cancellation as a normal result, settle each channel request once, and serialize access to the native picker.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Cancel, deny permission, double-tap, navigate away and trigger an I/O error. Every Future must settle once; a subsequent picker request must succeed.

knowledge_entries.title: Read selected files after changing the OH picker backend
knowledge_entries.problem: A file picker returns a selection, but the importer cannot read it after switching plugins, or its previous path/bytes fields no longer exist.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Adapt the importer to the selected-file object's content API; keep cancellation, empty content and read failure distinct instead of assuming every result is a local path.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Select a local file and, where supported, content without a directly usable local path. Verify CSV encoding and XLSX parsing, empty and malformed content, cancelled selection, denied or expired access, large input, and leaving the screen during reading. A successful selection must either load the intended bytes or report a specific read failure.

For a streaming adapter, also test ranged reads, premature EOF, invalid tokens, cancellation and detach during a native read. Measure memory during selection and consumption, and confirm descriptor counts return to their baseline after success and failure.

knowledge_entries.title: Select an OH plugin implementation that matches your Dart API
knowledge_entries.problem: A package resolves but its API differs from the examples, its OH implementation is missing, or a fork introduces dependency conflicts.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Resolve the app-facing package, platform interface and OH backend as one compatible dependency graph, and adapt callers to the selected API generation.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Inspect the resolved source and run the exact feature, not only dependency resolution. Check cancellation/errors and the same public API on your other supported platforms.

knowledge_entries.title: Check product and signing eligibility before promising a system capability
knowledge_entries.problem: An SDK exposes an API or permission, but an ordinary application cannot invoke the feature.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Gate the capability on API level, product scope, application type, actual grants and device support.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test eligible and denied configurations and verify the UI follows the actual capability result.

knowledge_entries.title: Enable and verify the Qt native accessibility bridge
knowledge_entries.problem: An ArkUI inspector sees only an XComponent and automation cannot find Qt controls.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Confirm the QPA contains its accessibility bridge, activate the supported launch option and query through the native accessibility consumer.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compare native control trees before/after activation and exercise focus/actions after resize and window recreation. Record accessibility separately from build/install.

knowledge_entries.title: Initialize Qt objects on the thread that owns its event loop
knowledge_entries.problem: QCoreApplication::notify asserts that the application main thread does not match the current thread.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Trace early Qt object initialization and keep Qt application construction aligned with the OH adapter's designated event-loop thread.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Observe thread identities through cold startup, callback delivery and shutdown; exercise the previously failing path.

knowledge_entries.title: Handle Qt close events according to their native origin
knowledge_entries.problem: A save prompt stalls termination or an ordinary window close is handled like system shutdown.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Distinguish interactive window closing from ability termination and persist incrementally instead of relying on shutdown UI.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test window close, task removal, termination and restart after unsaved edits.

knowledge_entries.title: Find target Qt packages without importing host libraries
knowledge_entries.problem: CMake cannot find Qt or a native dependency outside the OH toolchain root.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect root-path search policy and explicitly select the target package prefix before relaxing package lookup.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Configure from clean inputs and inspect imported targets plus final ELF architecture.

knowledge_entries.title: Establish native dialog ownership before creating its window
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt dialog appears as another task or loses close/wheel input while a sibling modal dialog is active.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Give dialogs a deliberate Qt/transient parent and, where supported, tag the native subwindow relationship before native creation.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test nested dialogs, modal siblings, close, scroll, task-switch entries and owner destruction.

knowledge_entries.title: Read dragged content at the supported drop stage
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt OH drop target can see MIME types but reads empty data during drag enter or movement.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use early drag events to negotiate accepted types and defer content consumption to the supported drop completion.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test text/files, cancel, unsupported types and delayed transfer.

knowledge_entries.title: Match Qt ICU probes to the SDK headers and libraries
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt configure reports ICU unavailable or compilation fails after forcing it on.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Check the SDK's real ICU headers, exported APIs and library layout before adjusting configure detection.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Run configure, compile affected modules and test representative collation, locale and time-zone operations.

knowledge_entries.title: Dispatch Qt native calls through the owning JS gateway
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt event-loop code needs an ArkTS/system API but cannot safely access Node-API objects directly.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use the selected integration's JS gateway and return copied native values instead of JS handles.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build a minimal call, verify thread identities and error propagation, and test delayed completion plus shutdown.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep OH out of unintended desktop Linux branches
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt compilation or runtime enters a Linux desktop branch that assumes desktop services.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Handle Q_OS_OHOS deliberately before broad Linux guards and exclude OH from incompatible qmake unix branches.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compile original and OH targets and exercise the affected platform branch.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve application initialization when adapting the native entrypoint
knowledge_entries.problem: A minimal OH entry shim launches a window with missing domain objects and crashes immediately.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Preserve the original application initialization contract before constructing its UI.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test first launch, invalid configuration and normal startup through the real application entrypoint.

knowledge_entries.title: Verify the selected QFileDialog backend before replacing it
knowledge_entries.problem: A migration disables QFileDialog or assumes a returned path is a completed user-visible export.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Try the selected QPA's implemented dialog route and validate result access and visibility separately.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test open/save/cancel, inaccessible destinations and reopening the saved file from the intended user workflow.

knowledge_entries.title: Reserve ArkTS chrome space around a Qt content view
knowledge_entries.problem: A hybrid OH PC app draws menus/toolbars in ArkTS over a Qt XComponent, but Qt content is occluded, docks are clipped, inline menus slide under the bottom bar, or tapping the hidden Qt menu bar crashes the app.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Measure ArkTS chrome in physical pixels, inset the whole Qt main window, send an explicit bottom limit for inline menus, and route only content-area input to Qt.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Resize the window and toggle toolbar groups; confirm the Qt content and docks stay inside the visible area and inline menus do not slide under the bottom bar. Tap the ArkTS chrome and verify no Qt menu opens; tap the content and verify normal interaction. Confirm no crash from a hidden-menu popup.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose oversized default fonts in Qt OH menus
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt menus or toolbars on OH PC render noticeably larger than the desktop build, causing clipped menu items or distorted layout even when the application stylesheet has no large font size.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Measure the QPA font metrics, logical DPI and scaling policy before overriding fonts; oversized menu and toolbar text can come from the font database, point-vs-pixel sizing or high-DPI policy.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compare minimal and real-app menu metrics against the desktop build at the same logical DPI. If the text size matches without contrived margins and the menu items are fully visible, the issue is resolved. Otherwise keep the observation unresolved with the measured font/DPI/QPA data.

knowledge_entries.title: Embed Qt file dialogs inside the authorized work folder
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt file dialogs on OH open outside the granted folder, show an empty or denied directory, or create extra windows when their look-in or file-type popups open.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Interpose the file-dialog statics, use a non-native QFileDialog embedded in the main window, start in the authorized work folder, and route combo popups to ArkTS instead of creating new windows.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Open and save a file inside the work folder; confirm the dialog renders inside the main window and starts in the granted root. Open the look-in and file-type dropdowns and confirm they use the ArkTS picker and create no extra window. Cancel and verify the caller gets an empty result, not a stale path.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose external clipboard paste failures in Qt OH apps
knowledge_entries.problem: Copying text inside a Qt OH app works, but text copied from another OH application cannot be pasted, even though the paste action is enabled and the widget is focused.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: When in-app copy works but external paste does nothing, isolate the QPA clipboard bridge, pasteboard permission, MIME formats and focus/selection before adding an application workaround.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: The issue is resolved only when a minimal Qt widget and the real app can both paste plain text and the supported rich formats copied from another application. Until then, record the QPA/runtime versions, observed formats/signals and the exact failure step so the gap can be reproduced.

knowledge_entries.title: Run a KDE Frameworks app with a minimal shim layer
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt/KDE app fails to build on OH because KF6 modules are missing, or its core flow depends on KLocalizedString, KAboutData, KColorScheme, KConfig or QML modules such as Kirigami.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Replace small KF6 value APIs with local shims, package QML fallback modules, persist preferences with QSettings, and disable large KDE-dependent flows behind MVP guards.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build without KF6 linked, launch on device, and complete the core flow: start a course, type, advance a lesson, persist a preference, restart, and confirm the setting survives. Confirm disabled editor/preferences entries fail cleanly and no KF6 library appears in the HAP's dependency closure.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep static plugin registration through link-time GC
knowledge_entries.problem: A plugin library loads successfully but its self-registering static objects never run, so formats or types are missing, while other plugins register correctly.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Link-time garbage collection can discard self-registering static objects that have no external reference; disable section GC for plugin targets or give the registration object an explicit reference.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Load the affected plugin and assert that its registry entry count increases and that opening a representative file succeeds. Confirm the linker flags for that target no longer discard the registration object.
