knowledge_entries.title: Load Qt application plugins from the install library directory
knowledge_entries.problem: Application plugins are packaged next to resources, but dlopen fails or every plugin reports that it cannot load even though the files exist.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: OH refuses to load shared libraries from the writable application data area; package application plugin .so files in the install library directory and explicitly preload them from there.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: On a device, confirm the plugin files exist under the install library directory, the startup log shows a successful preload for each, and the application's registry count increases. Exercise one operation that requires a plugin and confirm it no longer falls back to "unknown format" or an empty registry.

knowledge_entries.title: Bundle the Qt QML module tree into the HAP
knowledge_entries.problem: A QML app on OH shows a blank page, reports that a Qt Quick Controls or Layouts module is not installed, or crashes on a QML property the OH Qt build does not support.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Generate a QRC from the Qt SDK's QML module roots, patch incompatible QML in a copied tree, embed it under the Qt import prefix, and package the QML plugin libraries.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch the app and open each major screen that imports a different QML module. Confirm Controls, Layouts, Templates and Window modules load, dialogs render, and no property warnings or blank pages appear. Rebuild with a clean temp tree to prove the generated QRC is reproducible.

knowledge_entries.title: Resolve Qt resources from the HAP resource directory
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt app starts on OH but cannot find bundled data, translations or templates, especially when the path is derived from the executable location.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Ask the OH QPA for its resource directory and use it; do not infer an install prefix from the executable path, which points at the host shell in an OH process.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Start the app on a device and load a resource that uses native file I/O. Rename one packaged resource and confirm the app reports a clear missing-path error rather than silently using an empty path or crashing.

knowledge_entries.title: Launch a second Qt window in its own OH process
knowledge_entries.problem: A desktop-style Qt application needs an independent top-level window on OH PC, but embedding it in the first UIAbility shares one process, one window stage and one crash domain.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Declare the secondary window as an exported UIAbility in an isolation-only feature module, then start it from Qt with an explicit want and physical-pixel window geometry.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch the secondary window from the main app. Confirm it runs in a different process, appears at the expected physical position and size, receives its launch arguments, prompts for its declared permissions, and closes without terminating the main window. A failed start must return a non-zero code and a diagnostic message.

knowledge_entries.title: Export the Qt entrypoint from the OH shared library
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt application builds for OH, but launching the HAP does nothing or the host reports that the main symbol is null even though the application library loaded.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: OH Qt builds the application as a shared library; export main in the dynamic symbol table and make the library name in the ArkTS host match the packaged .so exactly.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch the app and confirm the host log shows the library opening and `main` being called. Independently confirm `main` is exported in the packaged library and that the host's library name resolves to the same file.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep OH system libraries out of the HAP
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt HAP exits immediately with a segmentation fault during Qt initialization after system libraries were copied into the package to satisfy DT_NEEDED entries.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Bundling device-provided libraries can make Qt initialization crash with SIGSEGV; resolve system libraries from the system partition and ship only application, Qt and C++ runtime libraries.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install on a 2in1 device and confirm the process starts without SIGSEGV. Compare the HAP's native libraries with the system set, and confirm the remaining `DT_NEEDED` entries resolve. Repeat the known-good control build through the same packaging chain.

knowledge_entries.title: Give Qt file operations a persistent work folder
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt app on OH needs repeated open/save operations, but each picker grant is temporary, dialogs reopen outside the granted tree after restart, or file writes fail with permission errors.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Ask once for a folder grant, store its URI and real path, persist the permission policy, re-activate on restart, and verify access with the ArkTS filesystem before pushing the path to Qt.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Pick a folder, open and save several files without further prompts, then restart and repeat. Confirm the grant is re-activated or a clean re-prompt appears. Revoke the permission in Settings and verify the app detects it and re-prompts rather than opening an empty dialog.

knowledge_entries.title: Resolve QtOhosExtras against the actual Qt generation
knowledge_entries.problem: QtOhosExtras package discovery, headers or enums fail after changing the Qt OH SDK.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect installed headers and build metadata instead of carrying Qt 5 public Extras recipes into Qt 6.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compile a minimal use against the installed headers, inspect the linked artifact and test the requested native capability.

knowledge_entries.title: Check texture completeness before treating black RGBA output as a decoder failure
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt3D RGBA textures appear black on a particular OH ZINK/OpenGL backend.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect mipmap generation, sampling filters and texture completeness before changing image format or blending policy.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test RGBA/RGB inputs, scaling/minification, alpha blending and release builds.

knowledge_entries.title: Separate missing Qt modules from unnecessary example dependencies
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt package discovery fails on UiTools or falls back to the wrong Qt major version.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect the installed target modules and determine whether the missing module is required by shipping code or only optional examples.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Configure core and optional targets independently and execute any retained module-backed feature.

knowledge_entries.title: Pass only supported initial locations to the Qt OH document picker
knowledge_entries.problem: The system picker reports it cannot open the initial application-private directory.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Leave the initial location unspecified unless the adapter can supply a supported user-document URI.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test no initial location, valid user-document location, private path and cancellation.

knowledge_entries.title: Translate Qt file filters without inventing native glob support
knowledge_entries.problem: An extensionless executable or other valid file disappears from an OH QFileDialog.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Translate only representable suffix filters and validate filename/content constraints after selection.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test extensionless names, multiple valid suffixes, unsupported patterns and cancellation.

knowledge_entries.title: Package Qt plugins in the loader layout expected by the selected SDK
knowledge_entries.problem: The app cannot load QPA, QSQLITE, image formats or the OH style despite packaging QtCore.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Deploy the selected Qt runtime and categorized plugins with their dependency closure and expected search layout.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Inspect package contents and runtime plugin diagnostics; enumerate SQL drivers, open a writable database and exercise required image/style plugins.

knowledge_entries.title: Fix indistinguishable QML controls by inspecting palette roles
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt QML controls render text but dark backgrounds merge into one black area.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect effective palette roles and apply a deliberate app palette only when the native mapping is unsuitable.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test light/dark changes, disabled controls, focus/hover and larger text on the target display.

knowledge_entries.title: Align Qt runtime, QPA and ArkTS startup templates
knowledge_entries.problem: Startup crashes with missing modules/modulesFactories, deviceInfo or undefined QPA handlers after replacing one native artifact.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use a compatible runtime/QPA/template set and inspect its actual startup contract before changing property names.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test a clean launch, warm Want delivery and module-backed features; inspect native fault logs as well as process survival.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep Qt resource initialization compatible with the exported entrypoint
knowledge_entries.problem: Linking an OH shared-library entry shim reports an undefined qInitResources symbol.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Compare C/C++ linkage and resource inclusion; keep explicit initialization in a C++ helper when it is required.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Inspect symbols and test access to representative resources in the packaged app.

knowledge_entries.title: Verify each Qt tray operation instead of trusting availability flags
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt tray availability check succeeds but geometry, menu state or notification callbacks do not behave as expected.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Trace the selected QPA's implemented status-bar operations and limit UI promises to observed capabilities.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test show/hide, icon change, menu activation, disabled/checkable requirements, tooltip gate and notification interaction separately.

knowledge_entries.title: Connect a Qt media player to OH AVSession
knowledge_entries.problem: Media keys, the system media notification or lock-screen controls do nothing for a Qt player on OH PC, or playback stops when the app loses foreground.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Create an audio AVSession, publish metadata, playback state and position, handle commands on the player's Qt thread, and unregister callbacks before destroying the session.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Start playback and confirm the system media card shows the title/duration and the correct state. Use media keys and notification actions for play, pause, stop, next/previous and seek. Background the app and confirm audio continues, then stop and confirm the session disappears without a callback-after-free crash.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep Qt and a GL translation layer on one state model
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt 6 app rendering through a GL translation layer on OH shows white or transparent 3D content, crashes on the first solid, or renders opaque or misplaced faces after Qt composites a frame.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Register native EGL contexts with the translation layer, restore the GLES state it missed, and invalidate program, buffer and vertex-attrib caches that Qt can change behind its back.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Render a 3D scene with opaque and transparent faces; create a solid and rotate it. Confirm no white viewport, no crash on the first draw, correct blending/depth, and no stale buffer/program state after a Qt composite. Compare a 2D-only window as a control.

knowledge_entries.title: Bound translated draw batches to avoid GPU device loss
knowledge_entries.problem: A complex Qt/OpenGL scene on OH freezes or the GPU resets after sustained rotation, while smaller scenes render fine.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep asynchronous client arrays alive, upload translated fixed-function arrays to a scratch VBO, and flush native draw batches at a small fixed limit instead of serializing every draw.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Rotate a large model continuously for several minutes. Confirm the process survives, no device-lost/reset/page-fault logs appear, and frame time remains usable. Compare with a small scene to confirm the throttle did not regress ordinary rendering.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep Qt High-DPI scaling single-counted on OH
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt app on OH PC renders at 2x or 4x, shows only the top-left quarter, clips menus, or positions popups incorrectly on a scaled display.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Let the platform screen's logical-DPI ratio own logical-to-native conversion; return 1.0 from the platform window DPR and keep platform geometry in native pixels.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Run on a scaled PC display and compare the backing-store image, surface buffer and platform geometry for the main window and a menu. All should be native-sized and 1:1. Open a popup at a known cursor position and confirm it lands there without clipping.

knowledge_entries.title: Hand a Qt video window to OH's native image pipeline
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt media application plays audio on OH but the video area stays black or washed out, or the decoder surface is lost when the video widget is recreated or resized.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Create a dedicated QOpenGLWindow, build an OH_NativeImage around an external OES texture, and register its native window with the media engine before playback.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Play a video and confirm the first frame appears, the image is not washed out, and resizing keeps the video aligned. Check logs for a non-zero buffer geometry, one surface creation, and frame callbacks. Rotate/close/open a second video without leaking the old native window.

knowledge_entries.title: Show a Qt splash in the same Ability
knowledge_entries.problem: A Qt desktop app on OH shows a tiny system logo, a blank large window or a window-switch animation during startup, or a separate QSplashScreen becomes a second Ability and is minimized behind the main window.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Hide the system starting window and host the splash as a frameless ArkUI subwindow inside the same UIAbility, then reveal the Qt main window when the app reports GUI-ready.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Cold-start on a 2in1 device and capture frames: only the splash should be visible initially, followed by a full main window with no white flash or window-switch animation. Confirm the final main-window geometry matches the pre-splash geometry, decorations are restored, and startup failure still reveals a usable window.

knowledge_entries.title: Composite subtitles over a Qt video texture on OH
knowledge_entries.problem: A subtitle track is selected on OH but no text appears, text subtitles work while ASS fails, or embedded ASS fails although an external ASS file works.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Draw text subtitles into a second RGBA texture and publish libass RGBA regions through a versioned C ABI bridge registered before video output starts.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Play a file with SRT and confirm text appears at the right position and disappears on cue. Repeat with external ASS and an embedded ASS track. Check that no stale subtitle remains after seeking or stop, and that subtitle delay changes take effect.

knowledge_entries.title: Route touch, mouse and keyboard input to Qt subwindows
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt menus and dialogs render on OH PC but clicks pass through to the main window, keyboard shortcuts do nothing, or wheel/trackpad events are ignored.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use the subwindow's ArkTS window filter for touch and axis events, the XComponent mouse callback for pointer input, and the XComponent key callback with an explicitly focused component for keys.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Click a menu item and confirm the action fires, open a dialog and click a button, type a character and press a shortcut, and scroll a list with a wheel or touch drag. Repeat with a real mouse/trackpad if available, and check that the main window does not receive duplicate clicks.

knowledge_entries.title: Render Qt menus and dialogs in their own OH subwindows
knowledge_entries.problem: Qt menus or dialogs are clipped to the main window, hidden behind an opaque white subwindow, or open with no visible content on OH PC.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Give each Qt popup/dialog its own system subwindow surface using a dual XComponent page: NODE for creation and input, SURFACE as the render target captured by the platform plugin.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Open a menu and a dialog and confirm they render inside their own system subwindows at native resolution. Screenshot the full menu, including shortcut text, and click a dialog button. The subwindow surface size should match its platform geometry, with no white cover or clipping.

knowledge_entries.title: Bound record pages by encoded bytes and explicit progress
knowledge_entries.problem: A record synchronization page exceeds the message ceiling or stalls after a short byte-limited page.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Budget encoded bytes including envelope overhead and treat exhaustion separately from page length.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test Unicode expansion, envelope overhead, one oversized record, a short nonterminal page and retries after partial acknowledged progress.

knowledge_entries.title: Reduce expensive effects and transition work on constrained devices
knowledge_entries.problem: Blurred surfaces or reader transitions drop frames or consume excessive memory on the intended OH devices.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Provide an explicit lower-cost visual path and schedule expensive work around interaction, preserving usable content while it completes.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Compare frame time, memory, visual quality and responsiveness on representative devices; test rapid navigation and persistence of the user's visual preference.

Also test tap, long press, touch-then-drag, scrolling while an effect is active, and simultaneous/nested scrolling. Confirm the idle decoration does not keep a ticker or trigger whole-card repainting.

knowledge_entries.title: Resume bounded file transfers without publishing incomplete data
knowledge_entries.problem: A mobile SSH/SFTP transfer stalls or reconnects and needs safe bounded resume plus an accurate final save result.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Use bounded ordered I/O, verified content identity and owned cancellation/deadlines; publish only verified bytes through supported destination adapters.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Test mid-read disconnect, a pending read when SSH closes, channel setup timeout, cancellation, reconnect, a same-sized changed remote file, truncation, checksum mismatch, low storage and destination failure. Confirm memory remains bounded, control traffic remains responsive and no incomplete file is reported as saved.

For uploads, test disconnect after acknowledged writes, manual retry to the same target, a wrong or oversized remote prefix, stalled writes, source mutation and removal during transfer. Verify task/host changes cannot attach an old completion to a new destination and that both local and remote staging follow their retention policy.

knowledge_entries.title: Give resumable uploads a stable target and an independent owner
knowledge_entries.problem: An upload retry creates another remote object or accepts an unrelated staged prefix.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Retain a transfer-owned remote target and immutable local content, validate identity on resume and separate navigation from transfer lifetime.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Disconnect after acknowledged writes and retry to the same target. Reject mismatched prefixes and changed local content; test draft removal, navigation, host switch and late completion.

knowledge_entries.title: Restore missing ReactCommon from an RNOH HAR
knowledge_entries.problem: The native RNOH build fails with add_subdirectory errors for third-party/rn/ReactCommon/yoga, jsi, cxxreact or callinvoker after installing the RNOH HAR.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: When ohpm installs the RNOH HAR but omits third-party/rn/ReactCommon, extract that tree from the local HAR into the installed native source directory and make the fix reproducible.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: From a clean install, apply the restore, run the native build and confirm no `add_subdirectory ... not an existing directory` errors remain. Check the packaged HAP for the RNOH native libraries. Remove `oh_modules`, reinstall, apply the reproducible fix, and confirm the same successful build.

knowledge_entries.title: Serve a harmony JS bundle through Metro
knowledge_entries.problem: The OH app starts but shows a blank screen, cannot resolve a .harmony module, or fails inside InitializeCore while the iOS and Android bundles work.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Add harmony to Metro's platform resolution, merge the RNOH Metro configuration, select RNOH's InitializeCore for that platform, and ship an explicitly built harmony bundle.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Launch the OH app with the development server, then with the packaged release bundle. Both should render the same root component. Confirm a `.harmony`-specific module resolves, no `InitializeCore` error appears, and the Android/iOS bundles still build.

knowledge_entries.title: Wire an RNOH native host into the OH HAP
knowledge_entries.problem: A React Native app has no HarmonyOS target, or the HAP builds but RNOH cannot find generated packages, a TurboModule or the registered root component.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Add the RNOH HAR and generated package, register every OH package in both C++ and ArkTS, and mount RNApp behind an RNAbility subclass.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Build and install the HAP. Confirm the root component renders, a generated TurboModule responds, and a package registered only in the ArkTS factory is rejected at startup rather than silently disappearing. Re-run codegen in a clean build to prove the generated package is reproducible.

knowledge_entries.title: Ship an RNOH app with an offline bundle, assets and fonts
knowledge_entries.problem: An RNOH app only works with Metro running, shows a blank screen offline, or loses icons and images because its fonts/assets are not packaged in the HAP.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Chain Hermes, bundled JS, sandbox file and Metro bundle providers; generate an offline harmony bundle with assets/fonts; and map icon font families to rawfile resources.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Install without Metro and confirm the app opens, images render and icon glyphs are correct. Then start Metro and confirm the development bundle is used. Change a visible string, regenerate the offline bundle, rebuild and confirm the new string appears without Metro.

knowledge_entries.title: Replace native React Native dependencies with OH-compatible packages
knowledge_entries.problem: A third-party React Native library has no HarmonyOS implementation, its native module is missing at runtime, or its HAR fails with an unresolved /ts record.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Map native dependencies to RNOH-compatible forks, install and register their HARs, and repair packages whose shipped HAR cannot resolve at runtime.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Open a screen that uses each replaced library and exercise one representative API. Confirm the app starts without a missing-record or duplicate-class error, the native package is registered, and permissions are requested by the target ability. Keep a list of features the fork does not support.

knowledge_entries.title: Complete native RTC joins and bind the intended remote participant
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH RTC bridge reports joined too early, displays a black remote view, or lets an old callback complete a later call.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Separate join acceptance, confirmed membership and media readiness; correlate callbacks and surfaces with the active call and authorized participant.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test invalid credentials, rejected join, timeout, rapid join replacement, leave/dispose while joining, a delayed old success, unexpected peers, peer reconnection and surface recreation. Confirm one terminal join result and correct peer/view binding.

knowledge_entries.title: Build and load a Rust library in a Flutter OH app
knowledge_entries.problem: Your Dart/Rust bridge works on another platform but OH cannot compile, package or initialize its native library.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Align the Rust target, OH native toolchain, bridge generator/runtime and application packaging as one integration.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Build from reproducible inputs, inspect architecture/exported symbols, then initialize and call the bridge in a release app, including error and large-data paths.

Check toolchain discovery with both a rustup-managed install and a distribution-provided shim, including explicit home variables and a missing managed directory. Confirm which compiler the hook actually invokes before attributing a failure to the OH target.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve the real Cargo and rustup environment
knowledge_entries.problem: A build hook derives Cargo home from a distribution shim and loses the intended toolchain.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Honor explicit Cargo/rustup configuration and derive a home only from a verified rustup-managed layout.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise a rustup-managed install, distribution shim, explicit CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME and missing managed directories; verify the actual compiler and unchanged explicit environment.

knowledge_entries.title: Distinguish OH target environment from desktop Linux cfg
knowledge_entries.problem: A Rust native dependency selects desktop integration for an OH target.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect target_os, target_env and framework-injected cfg separately and gate by the operation's actual platform semantics.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compile cfg probes and exercise the selected storage/system backend on the actual OH application.

knowledge_entries.title: Give path-based native code access to user-selected content
knowledge_entries.problem: A Rust/C/C++ library requires ordinary files, but a picker or incoming share provides a URI with limited or temporary access.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Import the selected content into app-owned storage when direct authorized access cannot satisfy the native library. Make the copy semantics explicit.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Check byte equality, zero-byte and large files, interrupted copies, insufficient storage, malicious relative names, symlinks and cleanup after cancellation.

knowledge_entries.title: Choose writable locations for shared and native application data
knowledge_entries.problem: Native code uses desktop HOME, a hard-coded bundle-derived location, or loses existing data after an application identity change.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Resolve application storage through the platform context/path provider and pass it explicitly to native services. Treat identity changes as data-migration decisions.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test first launch, restart, upgrades with existing data, storage errors and containment. Confirm the native engine uses the same resolved directory as the shared application layer.

knowledge_entries.title: Separate schedule consumption from completed delivery
knowledge_entries.problem: A scheduled action is consumed but runtime startup or its handler fails.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Track consumption, submission and acknowledgement separately, retaining bounded failure records without implying automatic retry.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Fail after schedule consumption, runtime startup and submission. Test missing acknowledgement, diagnostic-persistence failure, duplicate delivery and invalid activation during ordinary launch.

knowledge_entries.title: Fix missing Flutter APIs without assuming an OH limitation
knowledge_entries.problem: A widget, parameter, package or Dart language feature compiles on another Flutter SDK but fails on the chosen Flutter OH toolchain.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Compare the Flutter/Dart/API requirements first. Either align the toolchain or implement a narrowly scoped compatibility alternative.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Analyze with the actual OH SDK, resolve the intended packages and compare behavior of the compatibility path. Test the oldest supported device/API combination.

knowledge_entries.title: Store credentials using an appropriate OH backend
knowledge_entries.problem: A credential store works on Android/iOS but has no OH implementation, or a fallback stores secrets using ordinary preferences or custom encryption.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Select an OH credential-storage implementation with the required guarantees and preserve those guarantees through fallback, error and migration paths.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test write/read/delete, denied/unavailable backend, restart, migration and error handling. Inspect the actual native protection mechanism and unintended plaintext copies.

knowledge_entries.title: Share a database with a native extension deliberately
knowledge_entries.problem: A native extension opens an empty or incompatible store instead of application data.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Verify physical store identity and configuration, use one migration owner and scope extension access.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Populate through the primary owner, read through the native extension, and verify identical records/schema. Cover an absent store, mismatched paths, open failure, migration and simultaneous access.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep shared Dart code compilable with stock Flutter and Flutter OH
knowledge_entries.problem: Shared code fails stock Flutter analysis because it refers to an OH-only enum member, platform property or plugin type, even inside an OS check.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep the shared compilation surface free of unavailable symbols and isolate SDK-specific dependencies behind a deliberate platform abstraction.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Run both analysis paths from reproducible dependency states; build web where applicable. Confirm the OH build still selects and initializes its native backend.

knowledge_entries.title: Avoid SQLite read-to-write upgrade failures despite a busy timeout
knowledge_entries.problem: Independent native/plugin SQLite connections read successfully but an UPDATE fails immediately with SQLITE_BUSY or SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT even though a busy timeout is configured.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: For transactions that will read and then write, acquire write intent before reading and handle contention at transaction start with a bounded retry policy.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Use two independent connections to the same test database. Reproduce the deferred read followed by another connection's write and verify the resulting error. With immediate mode, confirm the second writer contends before reading; after the first commits, restart and reread the new value. Cover rollback, exhausted retries, long readers and the journal modes actually used by the packaged OH backend.

knowledge_entries.title: Reduce startup work without delaying correctness prerequisites
knowledge_entries.problem: First display is delayed by housekeeping or scans, or deferral starts consumers before storage and grants are ready.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Complete correctness prerequisites first, then schedule owned optional work after a usable first frame.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Measure cold first-frame and subsequent interaction costs separately. Verify no consumer runs before required grants/storage, and that deferred work is cancelled or ignored after owner disposal.

knowledge_entries.title: Diagnose C++ header failures from injected sysroot include order
knowledge_entries.problem: C++ standard headers fail with nullptr_t or math overload diagnostics in one OH build configuration.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Compare the actual failing include search order with a minimal toolchain build before adding type or header shims.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Compare minimal probe and full build commands after regeneration; verify no undesired include injection returns.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep system lyrics current and clear them in privacy mode
knowledge_entries.problem: OS-facing lyrics or media text survive track changes, reappear from queued writes, or remain visible after privacy mode is enabled.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Own synchronization at application/session scope, tag writes by native session, and actively clear the native surface when content is no longer allowed.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test rapid track switches, native session replacement, queued updates, privacy toggles, errors and restart while observing the real system surface.

knowledge_entries.title: Represent unavailable system metrics separately from zero
knowledge_entries.problem: A Linux-oriented system-information library returns empty CPU, disk or process statistics on OH.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Check each metric's real data source under app privileges and use an explicit unavailable result or supported native backend.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Exercise each required metric with known workload changes and with denied/unavailable data sources.

knowledge_entries.title: Schedule and cancel OH reminders after the application exits
knowledge_entries.problem: A reminder must fire while the application runtime is frozen or absent, and the application must later replace or cancel it using its own stable identifier.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Delegate due-time notifications to ReminderAgent and persist the mapping from application IDs to returned system reminder IDs; keep process-owned countdown updates separate.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Publish a future reminder, exit the application, and observe delivery. Restart and cancel or replace another pending reminder using the restored mapping. Test notification denial, overdue input, repeated IDs, concurrent replacement, publication failure, map-write failure and interruption between registration and persistence. Verify that process-owned countdown updates are reported separately from system-scheduled notifications.

knowledge_entries.title: Resolve terminal working directories in the selected host or guest namespace
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH app offers both a native shell and a Linux guest terminal, but starting the guest terminal fails because its directory is treated as a missing native mount.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Select the terminal backend before resolving its working directory, and translate guest locators without sending them through the native host filesystem resolver.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test guest root and descendants, spaces in names, a similar-prefix host path, a shared workspace, native-shell startup, unsupported types, missing guest assets and failed mount resolution. Confirm the terminal's actual current directory and that session wrappers preserve the same resolution policy.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep text size, font weight and system bold text from applying twice
knowledge_entries.problem: System text preferences unexpectedly change weight or a custom theme duplicates settings already propagated through MediaQuery.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect the embedding mapping, preserve inherited accessibility by default and remove duplicate native/theme transformations of the same system preference.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test system text size and bold/weight changes independently, follow-system and explicit app modes, restart, theme changes and native-view recreation. Confirm accessibility settings remain effective in the default mode and text remains readable with larger sizes.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep reply watchdogs and native protection separate
knowledge_entries.problem: A resume or network change starts redundant health probes and reconnects.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Share one pending transport probe, classify its result and coalesce reconnect work separately from native background eligibility.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test one delayed ping with multiple subscribers, timeout followed by a buffered reply, a blackholed connection, busy application RPC and network-event bursts. Confirm one probe and honest shared failure.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve typed values across a Dart–ArkTS channel
knowledge_entries.problem: A native session loses fields, serializes to unexpected JSON, or fails because channel arguments were treated like ordinary JavaScript objects.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Extract and validate an explicit typed payload at the channel boundary before passing it to application logic or JSON serialization.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Round-trip numbers, arrays, optional/null fields, Unicode and non-text binary bytes. Include empty buffers and bytes above 127; reject missing, malformed and oversized payloads and verify each call completes once.

knowledge_entries.title: Migrate string-encoded preferences to native JSON values by schema
knowledge_entries.problem: Preferences change from encoded strings to typed values or synchronize between schema versions.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Migrate only schema-declared keys and publish a complete validated snapshot with explicit version reconciliation.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Migrate valid legacy strings, ordinary JSON-looking text, explicit null, empty collections and invalid values. Inject publication failure and verify persisted bytes/caches remain consistent; test mixed-version peers.

knowledge_entries.title: Preserve UTF-8 payload bytes across shell and HTTP boundaries
knowledge_entries.problem: Non-ASCII text sent by a command-line HTTP client arrives garbled.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect encoded request bytes and pass a UTF-8 payload file or structured request body instead of relying on ambiguous shell argument encoding.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Round-trip Chinese text, emoji, quotes and newlines and compare the received decoded text with the original.

knowledge_entries.title: Fix video black screens without bypassing the backend contract
knowledge_entries.problem: Audio plays but no picture appears, or a video surface breaks when wrapped, resized or replaced with a raw Texture widget.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Keep the player widget, native surface and renderer lifecycle aligned; reduce layout/transforms only as a targeted diagnostic or workaround.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test first frame, multiple codecs, resizing/orientation, route disposal/recreation and backend switching. Use native decoder evidence for hardware-acceleration claims.

knowledge_entries.title: Fix platform-view hit testing and state loss during resize
knowledge_entries.problem: An embedded native view draws or receives taps at the wrong scale, or resizing/keyboard changes reset scroll position and controller state.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Locate the mismatch between native metrics, app scaling and widget lifetime before applying a scoped layout or embedding workaround.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry:
Test tap coordinates, multiple densities, keyboard open/close, window moves/resizes, scroll retention and restoration of temporary scale state.

For WebViews, vary app scale and page zoom separately and together. Verify links and text selection, navigation/reload, a page with its own root zoom, reset to 1x, user-script removal and the JavaScript-disabled case.

knowledge_entries.title: Connect a shared VPN core to OH tunnel lifecycle and routing
knowledge_entries.problem: You have a shared/native VPN core but need an OH implementation of consent, TUN ownership, routing and cleanup.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Map the core's network contract into a deliberate OH-native ownership model instead of copying another platform's service assumptions.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test denial, partial setup failure, route/prefix changes, gateway-less routes, self-traffic, reconnect and process teardown with the intended privileges/signing.

knowledge_entries.title: Replace a WebView backend without losing application behavior
knowledge_entries.problem: An OH-capable WebView compiles but login, JavaScript callbacks, navigation or off-page content parsing stops working.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Adapt the controller/event contract and view ownership explicitly; replacing the package source alone is insufficient.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test navigation, errors, cookies, JS round trips, delayed initialization, leaving the initiating screen and disposal while callbacks are pending.

knowledge_entries.title: Handle fullscreen and PiP across phone and desktop-style windows
knowledge_entries.problem: Fullscreen/PiP behavior works on one OH device but mis-scales a free window, leaves system bars wrong, or races an orientation change.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Model device category, native window mode, orientation and transition state as separate inputs, and base layout on the relevant combination.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test phone, tablet/free-window and desktop-style modes, rapid entry/exit, rotation, system bars, manual/automatic PiP and callback loss.

knowledge_entries.title: Separate requested visibility from focus and drawable surface state
knowledge_entries.problem: A PC window is brought forward but the framework still thinks it is hidden or has no drawable surface.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Reconcile platform window status, focus, framework visibility and surface readiness independently.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Test task switching, preload/restore, minimize/recover, close/reopen and surface recreation while comparing native and framework state.

knowledge_entries.title: Keep Windows build subprocess paths in the expected shell format
knowledge_entries.problem: A Windows native build loses backslashes in tool paths or Hvigor cannot spawn Java despite an installed JBR.
knowledge_entries.mechanism: Inspect the shell and environment actually inherited by the failing subprocess and use a compatible native command environment.
knowledge_entries.acceptance_plan_from_entry: Validate compiler and Java lookup in the chosen host environment and complete native compilation plus packaging.
